features.description: Effects and fiber lifecycle (effect runner, inertia, update/restart)
Context, registry, reflect, services, isolation, plugins
Logger service: buffer, exporters, name resolution
Loader: persisted entries reconciled against fibers

CordisShowcase iOS demo app: SwiftUI app (simulator + device) driving a Loader over showcase plugins (services, dependency injection, effects as UI contributions, config updates, failures, events, isolation realms, groups), with a testable ShowcaseKit engine
features.notes: Engine tests: swift test --package-path Examples/CordisShowcase/ShowcaseKit. UI tests: Examples/CordisShowcase/run.sh uitest (3 XCUITests, not in harness gates: ~1 min + simulator).

features.description: C4 architecture documentation (context, container, component, code, dynamic views) and a GitHub Pages site for the project
features.notes: Static site in docs/ (marked + mermaid from jsDelivr), served by GitHub Pages from main:/docs. docs/check.sh validates routes, links, images, anchors and C4 views; diagram rendering was checked in headless Chromium.

features.description: App Store release prep for the showcase app: display name Cordis Showcase, in-app About screen crediting the cordis team, citing the paper and linking the Swift port, release build settings (iPhone, privacy manifest, export compliance), signed Release archive, store metadata, privacy policy and screenshots
features.notes: Signed Release archive verified (Info.plist, privacy manifest, icon). App Store export/upload needs an Apple ID in Xcode or an ASC API key (exportArchive: No Accounts) plus the App Store Connect app record: see Examples/CordisShowcase/AppStore/RELEASE.md.

features.description: Per-user plugin activation from a server admin interface, as specified in docs/specs/0001-per-user-plugins.md: cordis-ios library changes (R-L1 to R-L5) and the CordisRemote target (sections 6.2 to 6.6) with acceptance tests 1-18
features.notes: Server (tests 19-28), admin UI and Epic Drives integration live outside this repo; tracked in Linear (Epic Drives project).
